brief:
A potential shift in Arab diplomatic strategy could undermine Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's grip on power, according to analysts cited by the Ma'an news agency. The assessment suggests that coordinated Arab moves might create circumstances capable of removing Netanyahu from office, though specific mechanisms remain unclear from available reporting.

The analysis points to regional diplomacy as a possible leverage point against Netanyahu's government, though details on which Arab states or what concrete steps are involved were not elaborated in the available account.

title: Arab states may decide Netanyahu's political fate, analysts say
